text:
[
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-3.2-1",
    "section": "3.2",
    "section_title": "System Requirements",
    "text": "The services shall be offered in and around Padmavathi Hospital within a radius of 25 sqkm/ or a set of specified PinCodes.",
    "kind": "constraint",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-3.2-2",
    "section": "3.2",
    "section_title": "System Requirements",
    "text": "Patients residing in this Zone can only register and apply for Appointments/ Consultation Requests.",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-3.2-3",
    "section": "3.2",
    "section_title": "System Requirements",
    "text": "There will be 1 Authorized Chemist per Pincode (24/7 Operations).",
    "kind": "constraint",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-3.2-4",
    "section": "3.2",
    "section_title": "System Requirements",
    "text": "All Prescription requests shall be routed to the Chemist after matching the Patient Pincode (from Address) to Chemist Pincode.",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-3.2-5",
    "section": "3.2",
    "section_title": "System Requirements",
    "text": "Chemist are supposed to deliver the medicines through Offline delivery and collect payments from Patients.",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": false,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-3.2-6",
    "section": "3.2",
    "section_title": "System Requirements",
    "text": "They shall mark the Prescription on completion of delivery.",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-3.2-7",
    "section": "3.2",
    "section_title": "System Requirements",
    "text": "There will be no systemic matching done to figure out efficiency of the Chemist.",
    "kind": "constraint",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-3.2-8",
    "section": "3.2",
    "section_title": "System Requirements",
    "text": "There will be 1 Authorised Laboratory per Pincode or there will be 1 Laboratory for the entire Zone.",
    "kind": "constraint",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-3.2-9",
    "section": "3.2",
    "section_title": "System Requirements",
    "text": "All Lab requests shall be routed to the Laboratory after matching the Patient Pincode.",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-3.2-10",
    "section": "3.2",
    "section_title": "System Requirements",
    "text": "Lab personnel shall make appointments and perform home collection of specimen.",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": false,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-3.2-11",
    "section": "3.2",
    "section_title": "System Requirements",
    "text": "This will be offline, also, they will email or send the reports to Patients directly.",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": false,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-3.2-12",
    "section": "3.2",
    "section_title": "System Requirements",
    "text": "Patients shall have the facility to upload upto 5 reports (upto 1 MB size) per Consultation.",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-3.2-13",
    "section": "3.2",
    "section_title": "System Requirements",
    "text": "Each Patient Consultation request shall be routed to 1 Doctor of a Speciality.",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-3.2-14",
    "section": "3.2",
    "section_title": "System Requirements",
    "text": "A Machine Learning Algorithm to assist doctors will be implemented to predict diseases based on Symptoms.",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-3.2-15",
    "section": "3.2",
    "section_title": "System Requirements",
    "text": "Doctors can accept or modify the diagnosis.",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-3.2-16",
    "section": "3.2",
    "section_title": "System Requirements",
    "text": "The responsibility shall be with Doctor to perform Diagnosis.",
    "kind": "constraint",
    "testable": false,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-3.2-17",
    "section": "3.2",
    "section_title": "System Requirements",
    "text": "The Machine Learning algorithm shall be trained using a training data set initially - post that the training set and the live data shall be combined to improve the quality of prediction.",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-3.2-18",
    "section": "3.2",
    "section_title": "System Requirements",
    "text": "It is expected that after a period of 1 year, the prediction from Machine Learning Algorithms will be approximately 50-60%.",
    "kind": "nonfunctional",
    "testable": false,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-3.2-19",
    "section": "3.2",
    "section_title": "System Requirements",
    "text": "In future, based on data, further analysis in terms of Seasonal Disease Predictions, Disease out-break due to demographic profile - patient segmentation based on age and gender shall be done to improve quality of Healthcare.",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": false,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-3.2-20",
    "section": "3.2",
    "section_title": "System Requirements",
    "text": "The system will have no provision to create a doctor roster or availability schedule.",
    "kind": "constraint",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-3.2-21",
    "section": "3.2",
    "section_title": "System Requirements",
    "text": "The patient appointment requests with date/time would be recorded, but no analysis done to validate if the doctor has the slot empty or there are multiple appointments made for the same time.",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-3.2-22",
    "section": "3.2",
    "section_title": "System Requirements",
    "text": "The system shall interface with a payment gateway for making Payments.",
    "kind": "interface",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-3.2-23",
    "section": "3.2",
    "section_title": "System Requirements",
    "text": "For patients preferring Appointments, a Cash mode of payment shall also be available at the Hospital.",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": false,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-3.2-24",
    "section": "3.2",
    "section_title": "System Requirements",
    "text": "For Offline Consultation, payments shall be vide. Credit/ Debit/ Net Banking enabled thru a Payment Gateway.",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-3.1-1",
    "section": "3.1",
    "section_title": "User Interfaces",
    "text": "All screens will be developed to work on a PC/Laptop.",
    "kind": "constraint",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-3.1-2",
    "section": "3.1",
    "section_title": "User Interfaces",
    "text": "Error messages will appear at the bottom and shall be self descriptive.",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-3.1-3",
    "section": "3.1",
    "section_title": "User Interfaces",
    "text": "The maximum size of error messages will be 80 Characters.",
    "kind": "constraint",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-3.1-4",
    "section": "3.1",
    "section_title": "User Interfaces",
    "text": "Buttons will be used to make the navigation simpler.",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-3.1-5",
    "section": "3.1",
    "section_title": "User Interfaces",
    "text": "Patient Registration and Consultation Requests screens will have bigger font size to aid Elderly people.",
    "kind": "nonfunctional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  }
]
